headline: Norse Atlantic Suspends Flights and Teeters on Verge of Bankruptcy
summary: Norwegian low-cost carrier Norse Atlantic suspended all flights for the day and stated it was teetering on the verge of bankruptcy due to surging jet fuel prices.
why: Airlines operate on tight margins and are highly sensitive to sudden spikes in jet fuel commodity costs.

impacts.name: Airlines sector
impacts.why: Soaring fuel costs severely squeeze carrier liquidity, risking insolvency for leveraged operators.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Severe operational cost pressures driven by fuel price spikes push distressed carriers toward insolvency.
